channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nuclear clock breakthrough could render atomic clocks obsolete
item.description: Scientists in Vienna have created the world's first self-stabilizing nuclear clock, a major advance in timekeeping technology.

item.title: Scientists discover hidden cleanup system in the eye
item.description: Researchers have found a previously unknown pathway at the back of the eye that drains fluid and waste, surprising scientists.

item.title: Tiny Injectable Device Controls Nerves to Treat Chronic Pain
item.description: Scientists have developed a small injectable device that can control nerve activity without surgery, batteries, or wires, potentially transforming treatment.

item.title: Neanderthals May Have Used Prehistoric Glue as Antibiotic
item.description: Neanderthals may have used a sticky substance from birch bark to treat wounds thousands of years before antibiotics. Researchers recreate.
